proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_of_fail_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: Fireball deals half damage on a successful save. The surface Effect type only has { kind: 'damage', amount } and { kind: 'none' }. 'Half as much' is a relative quantity: at base it is 4d6, but at slot 4 it is 4.5d6 — not expressible as an integer DiceExpr. The onSuccess amount cannot be independently specified as a DiceAmount that correctly tracks the upcasted onFail amount. A new variant { kind: 'half_of_fail_damage' } (no extra fields needed; the type implies half the onFail expression, rounded down per SRD) is the minimum honest addition.
proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d6 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one

notes: The core mechanic (AoE Dex save, damage on fail) fits the activation/save_gate family cleanly. Only the half-damage-on-success outcome is blocked — this is the canonical 'save half' pattern shared by Lightning Bolt, Cone of Cold, and many other evocation spells. A single new Effect variant would unblock all of them. Secondary effect: 'Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning' is a world-state/environmental effect with no foothold in the current surface; it is legitimately out-of-core for now and should be noted separately if environmental triggers are ever modeled.
